blogs.title: TAVI After Prosthetic Valve Endocarditis: When Is a Third Valve Worth It?
blogs.description: A deep dive into the evolving evidence and guideline nuances surrounding repeat transcatheter aortic valve implantation (TAVI) in patients who have survived prosthetic valve endocarditis (PVE). The post will outline infection‐clearance criteria (negative cultures, PET/CT/TEE), risk‑adjusted heart team decision making, comparative outcomes versus surgical explantation, and practical tips for communicating risk/benefit to patients with high operative risk.

blogs.title: Stacking Valves Safely: CT‑Guided Planning for a TAV‑in‑TAV‑in‑TAV Procedure
blogs.description: An instructional review of multi‑modality imaging strategies that make three‑layered transcatheter valve implants feasible. Topics include pre‑procedural MSCT workflow (annular sizing, frame overlap analysis, coronary ostial height calculations), use of 3‑D reconstruction software to model neo‑skirt formation, virtual implantation simulations for depth selection, and how these data inform device choice and need for coronary protection.

blogs.title: Avoiding Patient–Prosthesis Mismatch in Redo TAVR: Device Choice and Implantation Technique
blogs.description: Explores how to mitigate severe PPM when overlaying additional frames on a degenerated transcatheter valve. The article reviews hemodynamic consequences of stacked valves, compares supra‑annular versus intra‑annular devices (e.g., Acurate neo2 vs Evolut), discusses high vs low implantation depth strategies to maximize effective orifice area, and shares balloon post‑dilatation tactics that helped convert an initial mean gradient > 60 mm Hg to a durable < 30 mm Hg result.

blogs.title: Coronary Access After Multiple TAVRs: Alignment Strategies and Future Revascularization
blogs.description: Focuses on preserving coronary ostial patency and repeat PCI feasibility in patients with two or more overlapping transcatheter frames. Covers commissural alignment principles, fluoroscopic landmarks for optimal rotation, pre‑emptive coronary protection techniques (wire/balloon placement), and when to consider adjuncts such as BASILICA or leaflet laceration in complex anatomies.

blogs.title: Beyond the Third Valve: Emerging Tools—Bioprosthetic Valve Fracture & BASILICA—in Triple‑Stented Aortic Roots
blogs.description: Looks ahead at salvage options when structural degeneration recurs despite a third TAVI. The post outlines the theoretical application of bioprosthetic valve fracture and leaflet laceration techniques within a triple‑frame environment, technical considerations unique to self‑expanding versus balloon‑expandable valves, procedural safety data, and a decision algorithm that balances these novel interventions against the high risk of surgical explantation.
